deployments_detail.use: Strategic collaboration deploying Genesis Therapeutics' generative AI platform GEMS (Genesis Exploration of Molecular Space) to generate and optimize small-molecule therapies against selected complex targets. [Genesis Therapeutics (GEMS platform)]

Strategic collaboration using insitro's machine-learning-driven platform (integrating in vitro cellular data with human clinical data) to discover and develop novel therapies, initially for nonalcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH). [insitro]
deployments_detail.value: $15M upfront; deal worth up to $1.05B in milestones

deployments_detail.use: Multi-target research collaboration leveraging Terray Therapeutics' AI-driven Tnova platform (high-throughput chemical experimentation and generative AI) to discover and develop novel small-molecule therapies across multiple Gilead-selected targets. [Terray Therapeutics (Tnova platform)]

Expanded multi-year collaboration providing Gilead enterprise-wide access to Tempus' AI-driven Lens platform and multimodal real-world data (~3M genomic sequences, ~1.9B radiology images) to support oncology trial design, indication selection, biomarker strategy, and real-world evidence generation. [Tempus AI (Lens platform)]
deployments_detail.value: financial terms undisclosed; ~3M genomic sequences and ~1.9B radiology images available

deployments_detail.use: Generative AI / specialized LLMs on AWS to accelerate the target-assessment phase of drug discovery: querying scientific literature and databases via natural language, summarizing research, simulating molecular interactions, and generating synthesized reports with references; built on an AWS data-mesh platform (80% of compute/storage on AWS, 300+ data products). [AWS (generative AI / LLMs, data mesh)]
deployments_detail.value: expected to cut target-assessment timelines by several months; 80% of workloads on AWS, 300+ data products

deployments_detail.use: Strategic collaboration w/ Genesis Therapeutics (GEMS AI platform for small-molecule discovery, $35M+)

Expanded IT/business services partnership in which Cognizant applies its Neuro AI generative-AI platform (plus machine learning) to accelerate value creation and enhance Gilead's IT and business processes. [Cognizant (Neuro AI platform)]
deployments_detail.value: none (prior 2023 services agreement valued ~$800M over five years)

deployments_detail.use: AWS Amazon Kendra ML/NLP-powered enterprise search in the Pharmaceutical Development & Manufacturing (PDM) unit, indexing ~250,000 documents and ~1TB of unstructured data from nine enterprise systems via an S3 data lake; cut search times by roughly 50%. [AWS (Amazon Kendra, Amazon S3)]
deployments_detail.value: ~50% reduction in search time; ~250,000 documents and ~1TB indexed across 9 systems

deployments_detail.use: New Foster City biologics development and manufacturing hub designed as one of biopharma's most AI-enabled centers, featuring digitally enabled systems, autonomous robotics, and real-time digital monitoring (part of a $32B US investment). [none named]
deployments_detail.value: $32B US investment; facility projected to generate >$43B in economic value
